description_en: Creates a publish process for an entity in the new-version DataStudio
description_zh: 调用此接口，可以对新版数据开发中的实体创建一个发布流程
name: CreatePipelineRun

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.
This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the publish process is used to bring an entity online or offline.

Online: online

Offline: offline
parameters.help_zh:
表示发布流程是上线还是下线

Online：上线

Offline：下线
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The list of entity IDs that you want to publish in this publish process.
<notice>Only a single entity and its child entities can be published at a time. Only the first entity in this array and its child entities are published. Make sure that the length of this array is 1. Entities beyond the first one are ignored.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
本次发布流程希望发布的实体Id列表。
<notice>目前只支持对于单个实体及其子实体的发布，因此只有该array的第一个实体及其子实体会被发布成功。请确保该array的长度为1，超出1的部分会被忽略。></notice>
parameters.name: object_ids

parameters.example: This is a OdpsSQL-node publishing process. The function is XXXX.
parameters.help_en: The description of the publish process
parameters.help_zh: 对于发布流程的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The run mode of the publish process. Default value: Normal. If you set this parameter to Auto, the publish process is automatically driven to the specified stage. This parameter is used together with the AutoRunUntilStage parameter.

Valid values:
Normal
Auto
parameters.help_zh:
发布流程的运行模式，默认为Normal。当填写Auto时，会自动驱动该发布流程跑到指定阶段，需要配合AutoRunUntilStage字段使用。

可选值：
Normal
Auto
parameters.name: run_mode

parameters.help_en:
The code of the stage in the publish process. This parameter takes effect only when RunMode is set to Auto. After the publish process is created, it automatically runs to the specified stage.

<notice>The specified stage is automatically completed. For example, if you set this parameter to DEV, the automatic run stops after the DEV stage reaches the desired state.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
需要填写发布流程Stage对应的Code。当RunMode为Auto时生效，该发布流程会在创建后自动运行到指定阶段。

<notice>指定阶段会被自动运行完。例如填写DEV时，自动运行会在DEV阶段到达终态后停止。></notice>
parameters.name: auto_run_until_stage

Id.description_en: The unique identifier of the publish process
Id.description_zh: 发布流程的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
